question.worked_solution:
We need to isolate $x,$ so we will treat the other variables $w$ and $y$ as constants. We can use the addition and multiplication principles to solve for $x.$

First, we subtract $5w$ from both sides:

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =5w+7x \\ y-5w & =5w+7x-5w \\ y-5w & =7x\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we divide both sides by $7:$

$$
\begin{aligned}7x & =y-5w \\ \frac{7x}{7} & =\frac{y-5w}{7} \\ x & =\frac{y-5w}{7}\end{aligned}
$$
